annotations.title: Many maiſters,.
annotations.text: <mn>◦</mn> He meaneth principally Sect-maiſters that make them ſelues ſeueral Ringleaders in ſundry ſortes of new deuiſed doctrines: euery one arrogating to him ſelf to be maiſter, and none ſo humble as to be a ſcholer, either to Gods Church and true Paſtors, or to other guides and authors of the ſaid ſectes. So did Zuinglius diſdaine to be Luthers ſcholer, and Caluin to be the folower of Zuinglius.

notes.text: Many maisters are many proud Sect-maisters.
